title: The Mary Celeste
idea: December 1872: a ship is found sailing itself between the Azores and Portugal. Ten people gone, including a captain's wife and their two-year-old daughter. Six months of food, their belongings, a sound hull; only the lifeboat is missing. The last note on the log slate is nine days old. The famous warm tea is from a Conan Doyle story. The sextant and papers were taken; nine barrels had leaked. Best guess: fumes, the lifeboat on a rope, and the rope broke. Or something else?
hook: In 1872, a ship was found sailing itself across the Atlantic. All ten people aboard were gone.
caption:
December 1872. A ship is found sailing itself across the Atlantic, and all ten people aboard are gone, including the captain's wife and their two-year-old daughter. 🏮

Six months of food. Their clothes still folded. Only the lifeboat missing. And the warm tea on the table? That came from a story by Arthur Conan Doyle, twelve years later.

The sextant and the ship's papers were gone too: they left on purpose. Nine barrels had leaked, and alcohol fumes can explode. The best guess: they waited in the lifeboat on a rope, and the rope broke.

FUMES, BROKEN ROPE or SOMETHING ELSE? Tell us what you think happened 👇🦊
